blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Large Language Model (LLM) agents can handle increasingly complex tasks, navigating long trajectories of observations and actions. As these trajectories grow, key-value (KV) cache I/O and storage become the dominant cost. Trajectories can also exceed the LLM's maximum context length, requiring control over active cache growth. Prior work uses context engineering to reduce cache size by trimming or summarizing history. However, modifying the trajectory prefix invalidates subsequent cached states and triggers costly re-prefilling of retained context. Task accuracy can also suffer when too little context is retained to limit re-prefill costs. We propose cache engineering as a new scheme. It allows agents to directly control their active KV cache without modifying the trajectory or re-prefilling retained context. Specifically, agents can proactively use drop to exclude selected cache from future attention and repos to adjust retained keys' position encodings. We formalize these cache operations and identify history dependence as a serving challenge: identical token sequences can yield different cache states under different cache operation sequences, making prefix matching insufficient for correct cache reuse. Thus, we co-design the AKV serving engine. It provides a stateless interface compatible with existing serving APIs, while internally managing stateful cache reuse, eviction, and restoration. Experiments show that a tool-response rolling-drop cache policy improves average benchmark scores by 1.7 points and reduces average cost by 27.7%, compared with conventional threshold-triggered summarization. With AKV, it achieves up to 1.2x the output throughput and a 1.5x speedup in P95 request latency. Recursive self-improvement of cache policies further reduces cost by 7.1% over expert design. Our code is at https://github.com/thu-nics/AKV.
blocks.zh: 大语言模型(LLM)代理能够处理越来越复杂的任务,导航观测和行动的长期轨迹. 随着这些轨迹的增长,密钥值(KV)缓存I/O和存储成为主导成本. 轨迹也可以超过LLM的最大上下文长度,需要控制主动缓存生长. 先前的工作使用上下文工程来通过裁剪或总结历史来减少缓存大小. 然而,修改轨迹前缀会使随后的缓存状态失效,并引发对保留上下文进行成本高昂的重置. 如果保留的内容太少,无法限制重新准备费用,任务准确性也会受到影响。 我们提出缓存工程 作为一种新的计划。 它允许代理直接控制其活跃的KV缓存,而无需修改轨迹或重新预填保留上下文. 具体来说,代理可以主动使用滴滴将选定的缓存排除在将来的注意之外,并重置以调整保留键的位置编码. 我们把这些缓存操作正规化,并确定历史依赖性为服务挑战:相同的符号序列可以在不同的缓存操作序列下产生不同的缓存状态,使得前缀匹配不足以正确缓存再利用. 因此,我们共同设计AKV服务引擎. 它提供了一个与现有的服务API兼容的无国籍界面,同时在内部管理状态缓存再利用,驱逐,和恢复. 实验显示,与传统的阈值触发总和相比,工具响应滚动投放缓存政策将平均基准分数提高1.7分,平均成本降低27.7%。 与AKV一起,它可以实现高达1.2x的输出吞吐量,并在P95请求潜伏中实现1.5x加速. 自动改进缓存政策,使成本比专家设计进一步降低7.1%。 我们的代码在https://github.com/thu-nics/AKV上.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Large Language Model (LLM) agents are capable of increasingly long-horizon tasks.
Agents are generally composed of an LLM for reasoning and tool calling, and a harness that orchestrates tool execution and context.
Through repeated reasoning, tool use, and environment interactions, they can carry out complex work spanning hundreds of rounds ( Ye et al., 2025 ; Liu et al., 2025b ) .
blocks.zh:
大型语言模型(LLM)代理能够越来越长的视野任务.
代理人一般由用于推理和工具呼叫的LLM和用于协调工具执行和上下文的操纵器组成.
通过反复推理、工具使用和环境互动,它们可以进行数百轮的复杂工作(Ye等人,2025年;Liu等人,2025年b)。

blocks.en:
As agent trajectories grow longer, Key-Value (KV) cache growth poses challenges to both inference cost and task accuracy.
In terms of cost, retaining and repeatedly accessing accumulated KV caches incur substantial storage and I/O overhead ( Wu et al., 2026 ; Anthropic, 2026 ) . As shown in Figure 14 , KV cache reads take up 82.4% of the total API cost.
In terms of task accuracy, agents can suffer severe degradation if either the number of attended KV states or their positional range exceeds what LLM handles reliably ( Hsieh et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2026b ; Zhou et al., 2025 ) .
Therefore, it requires delicate control over the active KV cache for efficient and reliable agent execution.
blocks.zh:
随着代理轨迹增长更长,Key-Value(KV)缓存增长对推论成本和任务准确性提出了挑战.
就成本而言,保留和多次访问累积的KV缓存需要大量储存和I/O间接费用(Wu等人,2026年;Anthropic, 2026年)。 如图14所示,KV缓存占API总成本的82.4%。
就任务准确性而言,如果参加KV状态的人数或其位置范围超过LLM可靠处理的程度,则剂会严重降解(Hsieh等人,2024年;Chen等人,2026年b;Zhou等人,2025年)。
因此,它要求对活跃的KV缓存进行微妙的控制,以便高效和可靠的代理执行.

blocks.en:
Prior work reduces the growing cache via context engineering , typically by trimming or summarizing historical messages.
While older messages are often less useful, editing them changes the trajectory prefix, invalidates subsequent KV states, and triggers re-prefill.
The earlier the edit, the more retained trajectory suffix that must be re-prefilled.
Common harnesses therefore defer reductions until an active context length threshold is reached, then trim or summarize most of the trajectory and retain only a few recent rounds to keep re-prefill short ( Pi, 2026 ; OpenAI, 2026 ) .
Such aggressive reductions risk losing useful information from intermediate rounds, exposing a dilemma between re-prefill cost and task accuracy.
blocks.zh:
前期工作通过上下文工程减少不断增长的缓存,一般通过修剪或总结历史信息.
虽然更古老的信息往往不太有用,但编辑它们会改变轨迹前缀,使之后的KV状态无效,并触发重排.
编辑时间越早,必须重新填充的轨迹后缀就越保留.
因此,常见的牵引装置推迟减速,直到达到有效上下文长度阈值,然后修剪或总结大部分轨迹,并只保留最近几轮,以保持再预装短(Pi, 2026;OpenAI, 2026).
这种大幅度削减有可能失去中间回合的有用信息,暴露出重装费用与任务准确性之间的两难境地。

blocks.en:
In this paper, we introduce cache engineering , a new scheme for agents to directly control their active KV cache.
As shown in Figure 1 , instead of modifying the text trajectory, it excludes only selected KV entries from future attention, and reuses all retained KV states without re-prefill.
This allows agents to incrementally drop older KV entries while retaining more suffix KV within a given cost budget.
To support this control, alongside the usual append \operatorname{append} operation that adds KV states for new tokens, we introduce two additional cache operations. Drop \operatorname{Drop} removes selected KV entries from future attention, and repos \operatorname{repos} adjusts the positions encoded in retained keys.
Throughout execution, the LLM and harness choose when and how to apply these operations, repeatedly interleaving them with append \operatorname{append} to shape the active cache.
This programmable control also enables agents to search, evaluate, and refine cache engineering strategies through recursive self-improvement (RSI).
blocks.zh:
在本文中,我们引入了缓存工程,这是代理直接控制其活动KV缓存的新方案.
如图1所示,它没有修改文本轨迹,而是将选定的KV条目排除在未来关注之外,再利用所有保留的KV状态而不进行再预置.
这使得代理商可以在给定成本预算范围内,同时保留更多后缀KV的同时,逐渐放下旧的KV条目.
支持此控件, 除了通常的附加\ operatorname{ append} 操作外, 我们另引入两个缓存操作 。 放下\ operatorname{ Drop} 从未来的注意力中删除选中的 KV 项, 并重置\ operatorname{ repos} 调整保留密钥中编码的位置 。
在整个执行过程中, LLM 和 jap 选择何时和如何应用这些操作, 并反复与附件\ operatorname{ append} 互换它们来塑造活动缓存 。
这种可编程控制还使代理商能够通过递归自我改进(RSI)搜索,评价和完善缓存工程策略.

blocks.en:
However, the history-dependent nature of cache engineering challenges current LLM serving systems.
With standard KV caching, the token prefix fully determines the cached states ( Kwon et al., 2023 ; Zheng et al., 2024 ) .
In contrast, the same token prefix and retained positions can result in different cache states under different cache operation histories.
As shown in Figure 5 , trajectories ① and ② both retain KV entries for B and C, but C’s KV is computed with attention to A only in ①, due to the different ordering of drop and append operations.
The serving system must therefore account for both token and cache operation histories to correctly track or reuse cache states.
blocks.zh:
然而,缓存工程的历史依赖性对当前LLM服务系统提出了挑战.
以标准的KV缓存方式,符号前缀完全确定了缓存状态(Kwon等人,2023年;Zheng等人,2024年).
相比之下,相同的同物前缀和保留位置可能导致在不同的缓存操作历史下出现不同的缓存状态.
如图5所示,轨迹1和2都保留了B和C的KV条目,但由于投放和附加操作的顺序不同,C的KV在计算时只注意1中的A.
因此,服务系统必须同时记录符号和缓存操作历史,以正确跟踪或再利用缓存状态。

blocks.en:
Thus, we co-design AKV, a user-friendly and efficient serving system for cache engineering.
It provides a stateless interface compatible with existing API-based serving, while handling the complexity of stateful cache management internally.
Agents simply submit messages as usual, accompanied by cache operation instructions, without tracking which KV states remain resident on the server.
The system uses an extended radix tree for correct reuse and timely eviction of history-dependent cache states, while segment-batch attention efficiently reconstructs missing states in a single prefill pass.
AKV turns the theoretical efficiency potential of cache engineering into lower wall-clock latency and higher throughput for real-world agent workloads.
blocks.zh:
因此,我们共同设计AKV,这是一个方便用户和高效的缓存工程服务系统.
它提供了一个与现有的基于API的服务兼容的无国籍界面,同时在内部处理状态缓存管理的复杂性.
代理机构只是像往常一样提交消息,并附有缓存操作指令,而不跟踪KV表示仍然停留在服务器上.
该系统使用一个延伸的光栅树来正确再利用并及时清除依赖历史的缓存状态,而片段的注意则在单个的预填通道中高效重建缺失状态.
AKV将缓存工程的理论效率潜力转化为更低的墙时超时速和更高的吞吐量,用于现实世界的代理工作量.

blocks.en:
• Cache engineering formulation. We formalize cache engineering through explicit cache operations and their trajectories, providing a clear and deterministic description of history-dependent cache states.
This formulation also provides a programmable interface for agents to define and refine their own cache engineering strategies. • Serving system for cache engineering. We propose the first serving system that allows agents to directly control their caches, which were previously managed solely by the system.
We co-design a stateless interface, an extended radix tree, and segment-batch attention to support efficient cache reuse, eviction, and restoration. • Improving efficiency and benchmark performance. Across three LLMs and four agent benchmarks, a simple tool-response rolling-drop cache policy reduces average cost by 27.7% and improves average benchmark scores by 1.7 points, compared with conventional threshold-triggered summarization.
With AKV server, this translates to 1.18 × 1.18\times the output throughput and a 1.51 × 1.51\times speedup in P95 request latency.
An RSI-based policy additionally reduces cost by 7.1% on held-out tasks.
blocks.zh:
• 缓存工程设计。 我们通过明确的缓存操作及其轨迹,将缓存工程正规化,为历史依赖的缓存状态提供了明确和决定性的描述.
这种配方还提供了一个可编程接口,供代理商定义和完善自己的缓存工程策略. • 提供缓存工程系统。 我们提出第一个服务系统,允许代理直接控制其缓存,这些缓存以前完全由系统管理.
我们共同设计了一个无国籍的接口,一个延伸的光圈树,以及部分批量的关注,以支持高效的缓存再利用,驱逐,以及恢复. • 提高效率和基准业绩。 在三项有限责任公司和四项代理基准中,简单的工具反应滚动投放缓存政策将平均成本降低27.7%,并将平均基准分数提高1.7分,而传统的门槛触发总和化。
有了AKV服务器,这可以翻译为1.18×1.18\时间输出吞吐量,并在P95请求的空闲性中翻译为1.51×1.51\时间加速.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Agent context engineering .
At the text level, context engineering summarizes or trims interaction histories to reduce cost and enable agents to work beyond the LLM’s context window.
Existing methods trigger summarization through heuristics ( Wu et al., 2025 ) or agent decisions ( Ye et al., 2025 ; Sun et al., 2025 ) .
Further work improves summary quality through reinforcement learning ( Lu et al., 2025 ) or by optimizing compression guidelines ( Kang et al., 2025 ) .
To avoid the cost and complexity of summarization, trimming methods ( Lindenbauer et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ) directly remove less relevant context.
However, editing earlier context requires re-prefilling the retained suffix, creating a dilemma between re-prefill cost and information retention.
blocks.zh:
代理环境工程。
在文字层面,上下文工程总结或修剪交互历史,以减少成本,并使代理商能够在LLM上下文窗口之外工作。
现有方法通过休眠引发汇总 (Wu等人,2025年)或代理人决定(Ye等人,2025年;Sun等人,2025年)。
进一步的工作通过强化学习(Lu等人,2025年)或优化压缩准则(Kang等人,2025年),提高了简要质量。
为了避免求和的成本和复杂性,修饰方法(Lindenbauer等人,2025年;Zhang等人,2026年)直接删除了不太相关的上下文.
然而,早期的编辑上下文需要重新预装所保留的后缀,在重新预装成本与信息保存之间造成了两难.

blocks.en:
KV cache compression, eviction, and reuse .
At the cache level, prior work reduces cache size or approximately reuses existing states to lower storage, access, and computation costs. Compression methods use low-rank representations ( Liu et al., 2024a ; Wang et al., 2024a ) , quantization ( Liu et al., 2024b ; Liu et al., 2026b ) , or aggregation ( Fu et al., 2025b ; Wang et al., 2024b ) to represent cached entries more compactly. Eviction methods typically rely on low-level signals such as token positions ( Xiao et al., 2024 ) or attention-based importance ( Zhang et al., 2023 ; Li et al., 2024 ; Fu et al., 2025a ; Yang et al., 2026 ) to remove less useful cache entries. Reuse methods adapt cached states to different positions or context prefixes through position encoding adjustments ( Gao et al., 2024 ; Ma et al., 2026 ; Ordonez and Parnell, 2026 ) or partial recomputation ( Wang et al., 2025 ) .
Our work focuses on eviction and reuse, enabling high-level eviction decisions by agents and harnesses, while providing a practical serving engine for efficient cross-request reuse and isolation.
We discuss concurrent agent-oriented eviction work in Appendix A.5 .
blocks.zh:
KV 缓存压缩、 驱离和再利用 。
在缓存层面,前期工作会减少缓存大小或约复用现有状态,以降低存储,访问和计算成本. 压缩方法采用低级表示法(Liu等人,2024a); Wang等人,2024a),量化 (Liu等人, 2024b;Liu等人, 2026b),或聚合(Fu等人, 2025b;Wang等人, 2024b),以更为简洁地表示缓存条目. 迁移方法一般依靠低级信号,如象征性位置(萧等人,2024年)或基于注意力的重要性(张等人,2023年;李等人,2024年;傅等人,2025年a; Yang et al., 2026 ),以删除不太有用的缓存条目. 复用方法通过位置编码调整(Gao等人,2024年;Ma等人,2026年;Ordonez和Parnell,2026年)或部分复用(Wang等人,2025年)使缓存状态适应不同位置或上下文前缀.
我们的工作重点是驱逐和再利用,使代理人和工具能够作出高级别驱逐决定,同时为高效的交叉请求再利用和隔离提供实用的引擎。
我们在附录A.5中讨论了同时进行的以代理人为导向的驱逐工作。

blocks.en:
KV cache management in serving systems .
Beyond algorithmic designs, previous works also explore system optimizations for efficient cache storage, sharing, and request scheduling.
Existing systems use prefix caching to share KV states across requests with common prefixes while preserving equivalence to full prefill ( Zheng et al., 2024 ; Ye et al., 2024 ) .
For agent workloads, recent systems batch context edits to reduce cache invalidation ( Xu et al., 2026 ) or overlap re-prefill with ongoing execution to hide its latency ( Pan et al., 2026 ) .
For cache engineering, it additionally requires tracking cache operation histories, since identical token prefixes can produce different states under different operations.
blocks.zh:
服务系统中的 KV 缓存管理 。
除了算法设计之外,之前的作品还探索系统优化,以高效的缓存存储,共享,以及请求调度.
现有系统使用前缀缓存来共享 KV 状态,在请求中带有共同前缀,同时保留与完全预填的等值(郑等人,2024年;叶等人,2024年).
对于代理工作量,最近的系统批次上下文编辑以减少缓存无效(徐等人,2026年)或与正在进行的执行重叠重排以隐藏其暂时性(潘等人,2026年).
对于缓存工程,它还需要跟踪缓存操作历史,因为相同的符号前缀可以在不同的操作下产生不同的状态.

blocks.en: 3 Cache Engineering
blocks.zh: 3 缓存工程

blocks.en:
Cache engineering lets agents directly control their active KV cache without rewriting the trajectory or re-prefilling retained context.
We introduce basic concepts in Section 3.1 and design motivations in Section 3.2 , then formalize cache operations and their trajectories in Sections 3.3 and 3.4 .
blocks.zh:
缓存工程允许代理直接控制其活跃的KV缓存,而无需重写轨迹或重新预填保留上下文.
我们在第3.1节引入基本概念,在第3.2节引入设计动机,然后在第3.3和3.4节正式确定缓存操作及其轨迹。

An agent’s trajectory is the ordered text history used for the following model computation, including its prompt, assistant messages, and tool responses.
Formally, the trajectory is a logical token sequence x 1 : t x_{1:t} , and t t is its logical token length .

blocks.en:
In cache engineering, the cache size need not equal the logical token length.
We therefore define the active cache 𝒞 \mathcal{C} as the KV cache states available to subsequent attention.
The corresponding token sequence is the active context , whose length equals the number of token entries in 𝒞 \mathcal{C} .
Note that active refers to participation in attention at the algorithmic level, not physical cache residency in the serving engine.
A cache entry’s position encoding index can also be adjusted independently of its token’s logical index in the trajectory.
blocks.zh:
在缓存工程中,缓存大小不需要等同逻辑符号长度.
因此,我们将活动缓存 C\ mathcal{C} 定义为 KV 缓存状态可供后续注意 。
相应的符号序列是活动上下文,其长度等于C\mathcal{C}中的符号条目数.
注意活动是指在算法层面参与关注,而不是在服务引擎中的物理缓存居住.
缓存条目的位置编码索引也可以独立于其符号在轨迹中的逻辑索引来调整.

blocks.en:
Context engineering modifies the logical token sequence through trimming or summarization.
In contrast, cache engineering directly modifies the active cache through cache operations, while keeping the logical token sequence unchanged.
blocks.zh:
上下文工程通过修饰或归纳来修改逻辑符号序列.
相比之下,缓存工程通过缓存操作直接修改活动缓存,同时保持逻辑符号序列不变.

blocks.en: 3.2 Design Motivation
blocks.zh: 3.2 设计动力

blocks.en: The design of cache engineering stems from our thinking about three key questions: why direct cache modification is needed, which parts of the cache to retain, and how to manage its encoding positions. We discuss the motivations and empirical evidence guiding our design decisions below.
blocks.zh: 缓存工程的设计源于我们对三个关键问题的思考:为什么需要直接缓存修改,缓存的哪些部分需要保留,以及如何管理其编码位置. 我们讨论指导我们以下设计决定的动机和经验证据。

blocks.en:
Why modify the cache directly .
Cache engineering alleviates the dilemma between re-prefill cost and task accuracy in context engineering.
We evaluate GPT-OSS-120B on the first 100 BCP tasks, with four trials per task and at most 100 agent rounds.
Trim-based context engineering (retaining only the latest 12 rounds of tool responses) costs 1.85 × 1.85\times as much as the full-context baseline.
Summary-based context engineering (48k threshold) reduces cost by about 7% but lowers accuracy by 5 percentage points (Figure 4 ).
In contrast, directly dropping older tool-response cache can reuse the remaining cache, simultaneously improving accuracy and reducing cost (Figure 4 ).
The retained cache may also preserve information from dropped history used in its computation ( Xiao et al., 2024 ; Fu et al., 2026 ; Zou et al., 2025 ) , as shown in Figure 1 .
blocks.zh:
为什么直接修改缓存 。
缓存工程在上下文工程中缓解了重排成本和任务准确性之间的两难境地.
我们评价GPT-OSS-120B头100个BCP任务,每个任务有4个试验,最多100个代理回合.
基于Trim的上下文工程(仅保留最新的12轮工具响应)成本为1.85×1.85\时,与完整文本基线一样多.
基于摘要的背景工程(48k阈值)将成本降低约7%,但精度降低5个百分点(图4 ).
相比之下,直接投放旧的工具响应缓存可以重新使用剩余的缓存,同时提高准确性并降低成本(图4 )。
如图1所示,所保留的缓存还可能保留其计算中使用的从历史中掉落的信息(Xiao等人,2024年;Fu等人,2026年;Zou等人,2025年)。

blocks.en:
Which parts of the cache to retain .
Cache selection should reflect message roles, recency, and task needs, beyond token-level importance heuristics.
Figure 4 shows that older tokens receive less attention than recent ones, and tool responses receive less attention than assistant messages at comparable relative positions.
We therefore use tool-response rolling drop as our primary example, retaining cache for all reasoning and recent tool responses while dropping older tool-response cache.
We later explore alternative policies, including RSI-based cache engineering.
blocks.zh:
缓存的哪些部分要保留 。
缓存选择应反映信件角色、重任和任务需求,超出象征性重要性水平。
图4显示,与近期相比,较老的代币得到的关注较少,工具回复得到的关注也少于相对位置的助理信息.
因此,我们使用工具-响应滚动滴作为我们的主要例子,保留所有推理和最近工具响应的缓存,同时放下旧的工具-响应缓存。
我们后来探索了替代政策,包括基于RSI的缓存工程.

blocks.en:
How to manage position encodings .
By default, position encoding indices grow with the logical trajectory, even as the cache is reduced.
Dropping cache neither changes retained position encodings nor resets the next token’s position index, so indices can reach the model’s limit even with a small cache.
We decouple position encoding indices from logical indices and cache size, using a separate cache operation to reposition cached keys with RoPE rotations ( Su et al., 2023 ) without re-prefill.
blocks.zh:
如何管理位置编码.
默认情况下,即使缓存减少,位置编码指数也会随逻辑轨迹而增长.
丢弃缓存既不更改保留的位置编码,也不重置下一个令牌的位置索引,因此即使有一个小缓存,索引也可以达到模型的极限.
我们将位置编码索引与逻辑索引和缓存大小脱钩,使用单独的缓存操作,用RoPE旋转(Su等人,2023年)重新定位缓存键,而不进行再预置.

(3) We represent 𝒞 \mathcal{C} as a sequence of KV entries ordered by their logical indices, where [ ⋅ ; ⋅ ] [\cdot;\cdot] denotes concatenation.

Cache operation sequences are necessary because cache states are history-dependent: tokens and retained positions alone do not determine next-token probabilities.
For example, in Figure 5 , all three trajectories retain B B and C C , but A A ’s cache is available when computing both B B and C C in ①, only B B in ②, and neither in ③. Thus, C C ’s cache states are different in all three trajectories.
Similarly, repos \operatorname{repos} changes the position encodings used by later append \operatorname{append} operations, as shown in Figure 8 .
Correct cache reuse and restoration therefore require both token and cache operation histories.

因此,正确的缓存再利用和恢复需要符号和缓存操作历史。

blocks.en: 4 AKV Serving System
blocks.zh: 4个AKV服务系统

blocks.en:
AKV follows the principle of stateless interface, stateful serving .
Agents control the cache used in subsequent attention by specifying cache operations (Section 4.1 ), while the server handles physical cache reuse, eviction, and restoration internally (Section 4.2 ).
blocks.zh:
AKV遵循无国籍界面原则,
代理通过指定缓存操作来控制后续注意中使用的缓存(第4.1节),而服务器则在内部处理物理缓存再利用,驱离,恢复(第4.2节).

blocks.en: 4.1 Serving Interface
blocks.zh: 4.1 服务接口

blocks.en: Figure 6: Illustrative AKV request. Right-hand annotations show cache operations; m i m_{i} denotes message i i .
blocks.zh: 图6:说明性的AKV请求。 右手说明显示缓存操作; m i m_{i} 表示消息 i .

blocks.en: Figure 7: BCP accuracy by length with GPT-OSS-120B.
blocks.zh: 图7:与GPT-OSS-120B按长度分列的BCP精度.

blocks.en:
The serving interface must keep each request’s output distribution independent of physical cache residency and other requests’ cache operations.
For example, drop \operatorname{drop} must affect only the issuing request’s attention, leaving other requests’ output distributions unchanged even when they share the same prefix cache.
Each request must also fully describe the cache states it uses, without relying on physical cache retained from previous turns.
This allows the server to fully restore missing cache states if memory pressure causes eviction between turns.
blocks.zh:
服务接口必须使每个请求的产出分布独立于实际缓存居住权和其他请求缓存操作。
例如, drop\peratorname{ drop} 必须只影响发出请求的注意, 即使其它请求拥有相同的前缀缓存, 其输出分布也保持不变 。
每个请求还必须充分描述其使用的缓存状态,而不必依赖以前转弯时保留的物理缓存.
这样,如果内存压力在转弯之间导致驱离,服务器就可以完全恢复缺失的缓存状态.

blocks.en:
To meet these requirements, AKV extends the standard LLM serving API to specify both token and cache operation histories.
As shown in Figure 7 , the existing messages field provides the full logical token sequence, while the optional cache field specifies drop \operatorname{drop} and repos \operatorname{repos} operation sequence using an operate-after grammar.
Note that all entries in messages implicitly specify append \operatorname{append} operations.
Each key in drop identifies the message index after which to apply the operation; its value lists the message indices whose cache is dropped.
The reposition field lists the message indices after which to apply repos \operatorname{repos} .
Message indices are zero-based, and drop \operatorname{drop} precedes repos \operatorname{repos} when both occur at the same message boundary.
For multi-round agent workloads, clients extend the message and cache operation histories after each round, following the standard LLM serving workflow.
blocks.zh:
为了满足这些要求,AKV扩展了服务API的标准LLM,以指定符号和缓存操作历史.
如图7所示,现有消息字段提供了完整的逻辑符号序列,而可选缓存字段则指定了drop\opatorname{ drop},并使用操作后语法重新发布\opatorname{repos}操作序列.
注意信件中的所有条目默认指定了附件\ operatorname{ append} 操作 。
空投中的每个密钥都识别消息索引,然后应用操作;其值列出了缓存被丢弃的消息索引.
重新定位字段列出信件索引,然后应用 repos\peratorname{repos} 。
信件索引基于零, 当两者在同一信件边界上发生时, 将 \ operatorname{ drop} 放在 repos\ operatorname{ repos} 之前 。
对于多轮代理工作量,客户端按照标准的LLM服务工作流程,在每个回合之后延长消息和缓存操作历史.

blocks.en: 4.2 Cache State Management
blocks.zh: 4.2 缓存州管理层

blocks.en: 4.2.1 Design Objectives and Challenges
blocks.zh: 4.2.1 设计目标和挑战

blocks.en:
AKV aims to preserve three key properties of conventional LLM serving systems:
(1) reusing cached states if and only if they are equivalent to the required states,
(2) evicting unused cache states without compromising request isolation,
and (3) restoring evicted cache states within one prefill pass.
blocks.zh:
AKV旨在保留常规LLM服务系统的三种关键特性:
(1) 如果且只有在缓存状态相当于所需状态时,才重新使用缓存状态,
(2) 在不影响请求隔离的情况下驱逐未使用的缓存状态,
和(3)在一个预填通道内恢复被拆卸的缓存状态.

blocks.en:
Serving systems face three corresponding challenges in preserving these properties when supporting cache engineering:
(1) Token prefixes alone no longer determine cache states, so ordinary prefix matching can incorrectly reuse states from different cache operation histories (Figure 5 (b)).
(2) KV cache dropped by one request may still be needed by another, so evicting it without accounting for other requests can cause unnecessary recomputation or violate request isolation.
(3) Ordinary causal prefill cannot reproduce cache states resulting from drops and repositions, while replaying the operation history requires multiple forward passes.
AKV addresses these three challenges with an extended radix tree, drop-aware eviction, and segment-batch attention, respectively.
blocks.zh:
在支持缓存工程时,服务系统在维护这些属性方面面临三个相应的挑战:
(1)仅托肯前缀不再确定缓存状态,所以普通前缀匹配可以错误地重复使用不同缓存操作历史的状态(图5(b)).
(2)被一个请求所丢弃的KV缓存可能仍为另一个请求所需要,因此在不考虑其他请求的情况下将其驱逐可能会引起不必要的重判或违反请求隔离.
(3)普通的因果预填不能复制因掉落和重新定位而产生的缓存状态,而重播操作历史则需要多个前传通行证.
AKV分别通过延伸的光圈树,滴水意识的驱逐,以及片段的注意来应对这三项挑战.

blocks.en: 4.2.2 Drop-aware Cache Management
blocks.zh: 4.2.2 水滴意识缓存管理

blocks.en:
Reuse with drop nodes .
AKV extends radix-tree prefix matching with drop nodes.
When a request invokes drop \operatorname{drop} , AKV inserts a drop node Δ \Delta at the trigger point along the request’s path, recording the logical token indices whose cache is dropped.
Because drop \operatorname{drop} leaves retained states unchanged but affects subsequent attention computation, this placement preserves prefix sharing while distinguishing later states.
Prefix matching on the extended radix tree reuses cache along matched token and operation prefixes.
In Figure 5 (c), trajectories ① and ② share the A A – B B prefix but keep distinct C C states because they drop A A at different points, while trajectory ③ follows a separate branch.
When processing D D , each trajectory directly reuses its corresponding B B and C C caches.
blocks.zh:
重用滴结点.
AKV扩展radx-tree前缀与滴滴节点匹配.
当一个请求引用 drop\ operatorname{ drop} 时, AKV 在请求路径的触发点插入一个 drop 节点\\\ 德尔塔, 记录被放弃缓存的逻辑符号索引 。
由于 drop\peratorname{ drop} 的叶片保留状态不变但影响了后续的注意计算,此放置保留了前缀共享,同时区分了后面的状态.
延长的 radex 树再利用上 前缀匹配 缓存与匹配的符和操作前缀 。
在图5(c)中,轨迹1和2共用A – B B前缀,但保持明显的C状态,因为它们在不同点投A,而轨迹3则跟随单独的分支.
在处理 D D 时,每个轨迹直接重复其相应的 B B 和 C C 缓存.

blocks.en:
Evict with drop-awareness .
AKV uses drop information to reclaim unused cache before requests finish.
A cache entry becomes evictable only when no ongoing computation or restoration needs it.
For example, in Figure 5 , A A ’s cache can be freed once both requests ① and ② drop it, even as they continue generating D D .
Eviction frees the physical storage but leaves the tree node as an empty placeholder, keeping cached descendants accessible through prefix matching.
Among evictable cache entries, AKV prioritizes evicting dropped cache over cache from completed requests, since the latter is more likely to be reused in the next round.
blocks.zh:
{\fn黑体\fs22\bord1\shad0\3aHBE\4aH00\fscx67\fscy66\2cHFFFFFF\3cH808080}有意识的退缩
AKV使用滴信息在请求完成前恢复未使用的缓存.
缓存项只有在没有进行中的计算或恢复需要时才可被逐出。
例如,在图5中,A的缓存一旦同时请求1和2都放弃就可以释放,即使它们继续生成DD.
Eviction释放了物理存储,但留下树节点作为空位符,通过前缀匹配保持缓存的后代可访问.
在可驱逐的缓存条目中,AKV优先从已完成的缓存请求中驱逐掉掉的缓存,因为后者更有可能在下一轮重复使用.

blocks.en:
Restore with segment-batch attention .
AKV uses segment-batch attention to restore missing cache states in a single prefill pass.
At each layer, queries are split at drop trigger points, and each segment attends causally to its own tokens and to active cache from earlier segments.
Note that dropped cache is excluded from later segments but remains available to earlier segments that originally used it, as shown in Figure 10 .
Only attention is segmented, while the FFN processes the full sequence as one batch.
This avoids repeating FFN weight reads, a major source of memory traffic, for each segment.
blocks.zh:
以分节关注恢复 。
AKV使用片段批注的注意来恢复单个预填通道中缺失的缓存状态.
在每个层中,查询在跳动触发点进行分割,每个段会因果地处理自己的令牌,以及从早期段开始的主动缓存.
请注意,如图10所示,投放的缓存从以后的段中排除,但仍可供原先使用的较早的段使用。
只有注意是分开的,而FFN则以一个批处理整个序列.
这避免了每段的记忆流量主要来源FFN重读的重复.

blocks.en: 4.2.3 Reposition-aware Cache Management
blocks.zh: 4.2.3 重新定位-意识缓存管理

blocks.en:
While drop \operatorname{drop} leaves retained cache unchanged, repos \operatorname{repos} efficiently modifies its keys’ position encodings.
Different requests may therefore need the same cache with different position encodings.
Restoration must also reproduce the encodings used at each stage of computation.
blocks.zh:
放下\ operatorname{ drop} 保留缓存时不变, 重置\ operatorname{ repos} 高效修改其密钥位置编码 。
因此,不同的请求可能需要具有不同位置编码的同一缓存.
恢复还必须复制每个计算阶段所用的编码。

blocks.en:

(a) Two requests share A and B; Request 2 drops A before appending C.
(b) B and C initially occupy positions 1 and 2.
(c) repos \operatorname{repos} creates copies at positions 0 and 1 by re-encoding K and copying V.

blocks.zh:
图8:在 KV 池和 radex 树中重置\ operatorname{ repos} 。
(a) 两个请求共用A和B;请求2在附件C之前减少A。
(b) B和C最初占据1和2号阵地。
(c) 通过重新编码K和复制V,在0和1号位置重置操作器名称{repos}复制。

标签 p 表示位置 p.

blocks.en:
Reuse with key rotation .
AKV reuses cache after repos \operatorname{repos} by copying cached states and rotating keys, without recomputing hidden states.
In Figure 8 (c), request 2 copies B B and C C from positions 1 and 2 to positions 0 and 1, while request 1 continues using the original B B .
In the radix tree, these copies form a new branch with updated position indices and a reposition node after C C .
Prefix matching checks both token and operation histories: matching position indices allow direct reuse, while differing indices require key rotation.
Appendix A.1.2 explains why reposition nodes are necessary and details the matching rules and position transformations.
blocks.zh:
重用按键旋转 。
AKV通过复制缓存状态和旋转键,在重置\operatorname{repos}后重新使用缓存,而不重算隐藏状态.
在图8(c)中,要求从第1和第2号职位向第0和第1号职位提供2份B和C副本,而第1号请求继续使用原来的BB。
在radex树中,这些拷贝组成一个新的分支,具有更新的位置指数,并在C 之后重新定位节点.
前缀匹配检查符和操作历史:匹配位置指数允许直接重复使用,而不同的指数需要按键旋转.
附录A.1.2解释了为何有必要重新定位节点,并详细介绍了匹配规则和位置转换.

blocks.en:
Evict positional versions independently .
AKV evicts each position encoding versions independently, when it is no longer in use by any ongoing computation or restoration.
For example, in Figure 8 (c), the original B B remains in use by Request 1, while the original C C becomes evictable.
blocks.zh:
Evict 位置版本独立 。
AKV将每个位置编码版本独立驱逐,当它不再被任何正在进行的计算或恢复使用时.
例如,在图8(c)中,原先的B B被请求1仍在使用,而原来的C C 则变得可以驱逐.

blocks.en:
Restore with temporary KV versions .
AKV extends segment-batch attention so each segment uses the position encodings from its original computation.
Queries are also split at repos \operatorname{repos} trigger points.
At each layer, AKV rotates keys and copies values to create temporary KV versions for segments that require different positions, which we detail in Appendix A.1.1 .
blocks.zh:
用临时 KV 版本恢复 。
AKV扩展了片段批量的注意,因此每个片段都使用其原始计算中的位置编码.
查询也会在 repos\operatorname{ repos} 触发点进行分割 。
AKV每层都旋转密钥和复制值,为需要不同位置的片段创建临时KV版本,我们在附录A.1.1中详细介绍了这些版本.

blocks.en: 5.1 Setup
blocks.zh: 5.1 设置

blocks.en:
Baselines .
We compare AKV with two context engineering baselines that summarize accumulated history, following common practice in agent harnesses ( Anthropic, n.d. ; OpenAI, n.d. ) . Standard uses a higher, model-specific summarization threshold: 96K tokens for GPT-OSS-120B and MiniMax-M2.7, and 192K tokens for MiroThinker-1.7-Mini. Text Engineering uses the same summarization policy with a lower threshold of 48K tokens across all models.
For AKV, we use a tool-response rolling-drop policy that retains the KV states of the latest 12 tool responses.
Its repos \operatorname{repos} threshold matches Standard’s summarization threshold for each model.
blocks.zh:
基线
我们比较了AKV和两个背景工程基线,这些基线总结了累积的历史,遵循了在物剂牵引(Anthropic, n.d.;OpenAI, n.d.)中的常见做法。 标准使用更高的,模型特有的总称阈值:96K令牌用于GPT-OSS-120B和MiniMax-M2.7,192K令牌用于MiroThinker-1.7-Mini. Text Engineering采用相同的总和政策,在所有模型中最低阈值为48K令牌.
对于AKV,我们使用一个工具响应滚动投放政策,保留了最新的12个工具响应的KV状态.
它的重置操作器名{ repos} 阈值匹配标准对每个模型的归纳阈值 。

blocks.en:
Models and benchmarks .
We evaluate AKV across MiniMax-M2.7 ( Chen et al., 2026a ) , GPT-OSS-120B ( Agarwal et al., 2025 ) , and MiroThinker-1.7-Mini ( Team et al., 2026 ) LLMs.
GPT-OSS-120B is evaluated with high reasoning effort, while MiniMax-M2.7 and MiroThinker-1.7-Mini are evaluated in thinking mode.
The benchmarks cover various long-horizon agentic tasks, including BrowseComp-Plus ( Chen et al., 2025 ) (BCP), xbench-DeepSearch-2510 ( xbench, 2025 ) (xbench-DS), and the text-only 103-task
validation subset of GAIA ( Mialon et al., 2023 ) (GAIA-Text) for deep research, and SWE-Verified ( OpenAI, 2024 ) for software engineering.
Benchmark setup details are provided in Appendix A.2.1 .
blocks.zh:
模式和基准
我们通过MiniMax-M2.7评估AKV(Chen等人,2026a) ,GPT-OSS-120B(Agarwal等人,2025年)和MiroThinker-1.7-Mini(Team等人,2026年)法学硕士。
GPT-OSS-120B以高度的推理努力来评价,而MiniMax-M2.7和MiroThinker-1.7-Mini则以思维模式来评价.
这些基准涵盖了各种长视距代理任务,包括浏览Comp-Plus(Chen等人,2025年)(BCP),xbench-DeepSearch-2510(xbench,2025年)(xbench-DS),以及仅限文本的103个任务.
GAIA的验证子集(Mialon等人,2023年)(GAIA-Text)用于深层研究,SWE-Verifed(OpenAI,2024年)用于软件工程.
基准设置详情见附录A.2.1。

blocks.en:
Metrics .
We report success rate and mean per-task API cost for the main agent and its context-summary calls, in US cents unless otherwise specified.
Costs are computed from active input and generated output tokens using Groq’s rates ( Groq, n.d. ) for GPT-OSS-120B and MiniMax’s official rates for MiniMax-M2.7.
For MiroThinker-1.7-Mini, we use the official rates of its base model, Qwen3-30B-A3B ( Yang et al., 2025 ) . Detailed token prices are listed in Table 6 .
We additionally charge each token repos \operatorname{repos} by AKV at the cache-hit rate, deliberately overestimating the cost of key rotation for a conservative comparison.
For serving efficiency, we report request latency, time to first token (TTFT), and time per output token (TPOT), together with input and output throughput.
blocks.zh:
度量衡.
除非另有说明,否则我们报告主要代理商的成功率和平均每任务API的成本及其上下文摘要。
费用是使用Groq的费率(Groq, n.d.),GPT-OSS-120B的费率和MiniMax的公用费率计算出来的。
对于MiroThinker-1.7-Mini,我们使用其基准模型Qwen3-30B-A3B的官方率(杨等人,2025年). 详细的代币价格见表6。
由 AKV 以缓存- 重击率对每个令牌重置操作器名{ repos} 进行额外收费, 并故意高估密钥旋转的成本, 进行保守的比较 。
为了提高效率,我们报告要求的是耐久性、第一信号的时间(TTFT)和每个输出信号的时间(TPOT)以及投入和产出的吞吐量。

blocks.en:
Serving configuration .
Baselines run on SGLang ( Zheng et al., 2024 ) , which is also the base serving system of AKV.
Serving experiments use eight NVIDIA A800-80GB GPUs: four for prefill and four for decode, with tensor parallelism of four.
Since A800 GPU lacks native MXFP4 support, all LLM weights are set to BF16.
Further details are in Appendix A.1.3 .
blocks.zh:
服务配置.
基线在SGLang上运行(郑等人,2024年),这也是AKV的基地服务系统.
服务实验使用8个NVIDIA A800-80GB GPU:4个用于预填,4个用于解码,其拉伸平行性为4.
由于A800 GPU缺乏本土的MXFP4支持,所有LLM权重被设定为BF16.
详情见附录A.1.3。

blocks.en: 5.2 Performance
blocks.zh: 5.2 业绩

blocks.en: Table 1: Benchmark scores (pass rate, %) and costs (cents) by model and management method. Bold indicates the highest score and lowest cost within each model, including ties.
blocks.zh: 表1:按模式和管理方法分列的基准分数(通过率,%)和费用(百分数)。 粗体表示每个模型中得分最高,成本最低,包括领带.

blocks.en:
Agentic benchmark results .
As shown in Table 1 , AKV achieves the highest average success rates across three models, improving the average success rate by 1.3–2.1% and 0.9–8.7% compared with two baselines, respectively.
AKV also reduces inference cost by 27.7% relative to Standard and 21.9% relative to Text Engineering, averaged across all three models and four benchmarks.
Appendix A.4.2 details the saving breakdown.
blocks.zh:
原始基准结果
如表1所示,AKV在三种模式中的平均成功率最高,与两个基线相比,平均成功率分别提高了1.3-2.1%和0.9-8.7%。
AKV还比标准降低了27.7%的推论费用,比文本工程降低了21.9%,在所有三个模型和四个基准中均值.
附录A.4.2详细列出了节约细目。

blocks.en:
Source of accuracy improvements .
AKV better maintains accuracy beyond the baselines’ summarization thresholds.
On the first 100 BCP tasks with GPT-OSS-120B, all three methods achieve comparable accuracy below 48K logical tokens (Figure 7 ).
Text Engineering has the lowest accuracy in the 48–96K range, while Standard is lowest above 96K, following their respective 48K and 96K summarization thresholds.
This pattern is consistent with information loss from abrupt context reductions, whereas rolling drop removes older tool-response cache incrementally, as in Figure 14 .
blocks.zh:
准确性提高的来源
AKV最好保持精确度超过基线总和阈值。
在使用GPT-OSS-120B的首批100个BCP任务上,所有三种方法都实现了48K逻辑符号以下的可比精度(图7 ).
Text Engineering在48–96K范围内的精度最低,而标准则在96K以上的最低,遵循各自的48K和96K总和阈值.
这种模式与突然上下文减少造成的信息损失相一致,而滚动下降将逐步删除旧的工具反应缓存,如图14所示。

blocks.en: 5.3 Efficiency
blocks.zh: 5.3 效率

blocks.en: Table 2: Serving performance (latency, s; TTFT, s; TPOT, ms/token; throughput, tokens/s) of GPT-OSS-120B on Top-80 SWE-Verified across concurrency ( C C ) levels.
blocks.zh: 表2:不同货币(CC)水平的GPT-OSS-120B服务性能(纬度,s;TTFT,s;TPOT,ms/token;吞吐量,符号/s)。

blocks.en:
Serving efficiency .
As shown in Table 2 , AKV achieves higher throughput and lower request latency than both baselines across concurrency levels.
At their respective peak-throughput settings, AKV ( C = 14 C=14 ) achieves 1.36 × 1.36\times and 1.51 × 1.51\times speedups in mean and P95 request latency over Standard ( C = 12 C=12 ), respectively.
Input and output throughput are 1.53 × 1.53\times and 1.18 × 1.18\times those of Standard.
Here, input throughput counts all logical input tokens, including those whose cache has been dropped.
The workload and measurement protocol are detailed in Appendix A.1.4 .
AKV’s throughput and latency advantages over Standard widen at high concurrency ( C ≥ 14 C\geq 14 ), as KV-cache pressure increases Standard’s re-prefill work. As a result, fewer Standard requests can decode concurrently, yielding higher end-to-end latency and lower throughput.
blocks.zh:
服务效率
如表2所示,AKV实现的吞吐量和请求延迟度均高于所有货币水平的基线。
在各自的峰值通量设置中,AKV(C=14 C=14)分别实现1.36×1.36\时和1.51×1.51\时速的中速和P95请求在标准(C=12 C=12)时的休息.
输入和输出吞吐量为1.53×1.53\时,1.18×1.18\时为标准.
在这里,输入的吞吐量算上所有逻辑输入符,包括缓存被丢弃的符.
工作量和计量规程详见附录A.1.4。
AKV的吞吐量和耐久性优势比标准高通量(C 14 C\geq 14),因为KV-cache压力增加了标准的再预装工作。 因此,较少的标准请求可以同时解码,从而产生更高的端对端延迟和较低的吞吐量.

blocks.en:
Source of efficiency improvements .
Figure 12 in Appendix A.4.1 shows that the decode speedup comes mainly from reduced full-attention time.
Dropping older tool-response cache shortens the active context, reducing both KV reads and attention computation at each decode step.
blocks.zh:
提高效率的来源
附录A.4.1中的图12显示,解码速度主要来自减少全程注意时间.
丢弃较旧的工具-响应缓存会缩短活动上下文,减少KV读取和每个解码步骤的注意力计算.

blocks.en:
Real-world task acceleration .
In Figure 9 (a), AKV reaches the highest final pass rate in the least GPU time.
This online evaluation uses GPT-OSS-120B on the first 100 SWE-bench Verified tasks, with each method running at its peak-throughput concurrency.
This advantage combines gains in task performance and serving efficiency.
Figure 9 (b) shows that AKV continues to improve its pass rate as cumulative logical input tokens increase, ultimately outperforming both baselines.
Figure 9 (c) shows higher peak serving throughput, allowing AKV to process these trajectories faster.
blocks.zh:
现实世界任务加速.
在图9(a)中,AKV在最少的GPU时间内达到最高的最终通过率.
这一在线评价在首批100个SWE-bench验证任务上使用GPT-OSS-120B,每种方法都按其峰值通量计算。
这一优势将任务业绩的提高与服务效率相结合。
图9(b)显示,随着累积逻辑输入符号的增加,AKV继续提高其通过率,最终优于两个基线。
图9(c)显示服务吞吐量最高,使AKV能够更快地处理这些轨迹。

blocks.en: 5.4 Ablations and Cache Engineering Policies
blocks.zh: 5.4 缓存和缓存工程政策

blocks.en: Table 3: Drop-target and repos \operatorname{repos} ablations with GPT-OSS-120B on each benchmark’s first 100 tasks.
blocks.zh: 表 3: 在每个基准头100项任务中, 投放目标与重置操作器名称{ repos} 与 GPT-OSS-120B 混合。

blocks.en: Table 4: Agentic cache reduction on a 100-task BCP subset. CAT means Cache-As-Tool.
blocks.zh: 表4:100任务BCP子集的代理缓存减少. CAT指卡切-阿斯图尔.

blocks.en:
Ablation study .
Table 4 compares drop targets and the use of repos \operatorname{repos} , showing that tool-response drop with repos \operatorname{repos} achieves the highest pass rate on both benchmarks.
Adding repos \operatorname{repos} raises BCP’s pass rate from 55% to 62%, allowing exploration beyond the position limit that would otherwise halt execution.
With repos \operatorname{repos} enabled, dropping reasoning cache, either alone or together with tool-response cache, yields lower pass rates on both benchmarks than dropping tool-response cache alone.
blocks.zh:
校勘研究.
表4比较了投放目标以及使用 repos\peratorname{repos},显示用 repos\peratorname{repos} 来进行工具响应的投放,实现了两个基准中最高的通过率.
添加 repos\peratorname{repos} 可将 BCP 的通过率从 55% 提升到 62%, 从而允许探索超越位置限制, 否则会停止执行 。
启用 repos\peratorname{repos} 后, 单独或与工具响应缓存一起丢弃推理缓存, 使两个基准的通过率低于单独丢弃工具响应缓存。

blocks.en:
Recursive self-improvement (RSI) .
Figure 4 shows that RSI finds lower-cost cache policies than our manually designed tool-response rolling-drop policy ( K = 12 K=12 ) while maintaining Standard’s accuracy.
We use MiniMax-M2.7 to refine policies on 20 BCP tasks and evaluate the resulting policies on 100 held-out tasks.
The policies from iterations 3 and 6 reduce per-task cost by 15.6% and 17.8% relative to Standard, respectively.
blocks.zh:
递归自修(RSI).
图4显示,RSI发现的缓存政策比我们手工设计的工具响应滚动投放政策(K = 12 K = 12)成本低,同时保持标准的准确性.
我们利用MiniMax-M2.7改进关于20个业务流程控制任务的政策,并评价由此产生的关于100个搁置任务的政策。
3号和6号重联的政策分别比标准降低15.6%和17.8%。

blocks.en:
Cache management as a tool .
Exposing cache management as a tool lets agents proactively decide when to reduce the cache and what to retain.
Table 4 shows that this approach achieves the highest pass rate on a 100-task BCP subset for both models: 61.0% for GPT-OSS-120B and 64.0% for MiniMax-M2.7.
Compared with Standard, GPT-OSS-120B’s per-task cost falls from 13.4 to 12.1 cents, while MiniMax-M2.7’s rises from 5.4 to 5.9 cents as it executes more turns.
blocks.zh:
作为工具的缓存管理 。
将缓存管理作为一种工具进行曝光,让代理主动决定何时减少缓存以及保留什么.
表4显示,这种方法在两个模型的100任务BCP子集上达到最高的通过率:GPT-OSS-120B为61.0%,MiniMax-M2.7为64.0%。
与标准相比,GPT-OSS-120B的每任务成本从13.4美分下降到12.1美分,而Minimax-M2.7的每任务成本随着执行更多的转弯从5.4美分上升到5.9美分.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en:
We introduce cache engineering, enabling agents to directly manage active KV states while reusing retained caches without recomputation.
We co-design the AKV serving system to support cache engineering through a stateless interface, an extended radix tree, and segment-batch attention for efficient cache reuse, eviction, and restoration.
Across agent benchmarks, cache engineering improves average task performance while reducing inference costs, with AKV translating these efficiency gains into higher serving throughput and lower latency.
blocks.zh:
我们引入缓存工程,使代理能够直接管理活跃的KV状态,同时重用保留缓存而不重算.
我们共同设计AKV服务系统,支持缓存工程,通过一个无国籍的接口,一个扩展的光圈树,以及用于高效缓存再利用,驱离和恢复的片段批量关注.
纵观代理基准,缓存工程提高了平均任务绩效,同时降低了推论成本,AKV将这些增效转化为更高的服务吞吐量和较低的延迟.

blocks.en:
Limitations .
Further exploration of cache engineering strategies, training agents under this scheme, and extending serving support to linear attention models remain future work.
blocks.zh:
限制
进一步探索缓存工程战略,本办法下的培训代理商,向线性关注模式提供服务支持,仍然是今后的工作.

blocks.en: A.1.1 Restore with Segment-batch Attention
blocks.zh: A.1.1 分节注意恢复

blocks.en:
Segmentation .
Building on Sections 4.2.2 and 4.2.3 , AKV restores missing KV states by partitioning queries whenever a drop \operatorname{drop} or repos \operatorname{repos} operation changes the visible history or its position mapping.
Each segment selects the corresponding KV pages and applies standard causal attention, encoding historical visibility without constructing a dense custom mask.

Batched restoration .
Within each layer, AKV writes the newly computed KV states and constructs the additional position versions, such as C 1 C_{1} and E 2 E_{2} , by re-encoding K and copying V.
The segment-specific page lists and query ranges are then submitted together to batched attention.

blocks.en: A.1.2 Reposition Scheme
blocks.zh: A.1.2 重新定位计划

blocks.en:
Design objective .
Reposition-aware cache management must distinguish positional versions while reusing their shared computational states.
We therefore first identify directly reusable caches via exact matching, then use retrigger matching to find prefixes that are reusable via positional transformation, avoiding unnecessary hidden-state recomputation.
blocks.zh:
设计目标.
重新定位-意识缓存管理必须区分位置版本,同时重用其共享的计算状态.
因此,我们首先通过精确的匹配来识别直接可重复使用的缓存,然后使用 retrigger 匹配来找到通过位置转换可重复使用的前缀,避免不必要的隐藏状态重算.

blocks.en:
Token-node representation .
Each token node is represented as T ⁡ ( x , p ) T(x,p) , where x x is the token ID and p p is the position currently encoded in its cached K.
The position label describes the stored cache, not necessarily the position at which the token was originally computed.
For example, C C is initially computed at position 2 in all three trajectories in Figure 11 .
After repos \operatorname{repos} , trajectories 1 and 3 use ( C , 0 ) (C,0) , while trajectory 2 uses ( C , 1 ) (C,1) .
Operation nodes along the path preserve the operation history that governs computation.

托肯-诺德代表

沿路径的操作节点保留了管理计算工作的操作历史.

blocks.en: Why position labels and reposition nodes are needed .
blocks.zh: 为何需要定位标签和重新定位节点 。

blocks.en:
Position labels distinguish cache representations that cannot be used interchangeably.
For example, C C has the same original computation history in trajectories 1 and 2, but is repositioned to 0 and 1, respectively.
Its K encodings therefore differ and require positional transformation before reuse.
blocks.zh:

因此,其K编码不同,需要在再利用之前进行位置转换。

blocks.en:

When D D is computed, the positions of A A , C C , and D D are respectively ( 0 , 2 , 3 ) (0,2,3) and ( 0 , 1 , 2 ) (0,1,2) .
The relative distance between D D and A A changes, while that between D D and C C remains unchanged, potentially producing different hidden states and KV entries for D D .
Both trajectories subsequently drop A A and execute R D R_{D} to move C C and D D to positions 0 and 1.
This later transformation cannot erase the computational difference already established in D D .
The path must therefore retain R C R_{C} before D D to prevent incorrect reuse of D D and subsequent cached states.

The system initializes the result with the longest valid exact prefix, then searches compatible branches from the root.
A candidate replaces the current result only if it is valid and matches a strictly longer prefix, preserving exact matches in a tie.

Correctness of retrigger matching .
Under fixed model and position encoding configurations and exact arithmetic, identical projected prefixes preserve the token and operation history preceding each token’s original computation.
They therefore produce the same hidden states and unrotated KV content. blocks.en: A.1.4 Workload Replay and Evaluation Protocol
blocks.zh: A.1.4 工作量重演和评价议定书

blocks.en:
Task selection .
To emulate realistic long-horizon agent workloads with substantial accumulated context, we select the 80 SWE-bench Verified tasks with the largest context lengths in trajectories, without any summary operation. These tasks reflect the difficulty of tasks in long-context reasoning.
We rank tasks by this peak length and shuffle the selected tasks with a fixed seed.
All methods use the same tasks and ordering.
Each method replays trajectories collected under its own context/cache engineering policy, so the number of turns and the output budgets may differ between methods.
blocks.zh:
任务选择 。
为了效仿具有大量累积背景的现实的长视距代理工作量,我们选择80个SWE-bench验证任务,在轨距上,其上下文长度最大,不做任何简易操作. 这些任务反映了长文推理中任务的难度.
我们按这个峰值长度排列任务,用固定的种子来洗涤选定的任务.
所有方法都使用同样的任务和顺序.
每种方法都重播根据自身上下文/cache工程政策收集的轨迹,因此转弯次数和产出预算可能因方法而异.

blocks.en:
Trajectory replay .
For each turn, we reconstruct the output token budget from the complete recorded message history, including reasoning and tool-call content, after subtracting the generation prefix already present in the input.
We use temperature 0 and ignore_eos=True to generate the prescribed number of tokens.
The newly generated assistant response is retained in the history for subsequent turns, while tool responses are replayed from the recorded trajectory rather than re-executing the tools.
Recorded terminal inputs without an available assistant response are excluded from replay.
blocks.zh:
轨迹回放.
对于每个转弯,我们从完整记录的信息历史中重建输出符号预算,包括推理和工具调用内容,然后减去输入中已经存在的生成前缀.
我们使用温度0,忽略_eos= 真能生成指定的符数 。
新生成的助手响应被保留在历史中供以后的转折,而工具响应则从记录的轨迹中重播,而不是重新激活工具.
没有可用助手响应的录音终端输入被排除于重播之外.

blocks.en:
Concurrency and measurement windows .
We maintain C C client task concurrency and execute turns sequentially within each task.
The task-count target for each measurement window is max ⁡ ( 3 × C , 30 ) \max(3\times C,30) ; measurements include requests from supplemental tasks used to maintain concurrency.
For AKV at C ∈ { 14 , 16 } C\in\{14,16\} , we truncate the archived runs at the completion of the first 30 tasks in completion order, counting all requests within the resulting window rather than only requests from those 30 completed tasks.
For Standard at large concurrency, KV cache capacity pressure causes repeated prefill, resulting in severe serving degradation.
We therefore report these two runs over a fixed one-hour window, with some requests still unfinished at the cutoff.

货币和计量窗口
我们保持C客户端任务货币化,并在每项任务中依次执行回合。
每个测量窗口的任务计数目标为最大QQ( 3 × C, 30)\max( 3\time C, 30) ; 测量包括用于维持货币的补充任务的请求 。
对于 AKV at C { { 14, 16} C\in{ { 14, 16} , 我们在完成前30项任务的顺序时, 缩短存档运行, 计及所产生的窗口内的所有请求, 而不仅仅是这30项已完成任务的请求 。
就一般货币标准而言,KV缓存容量压力导致重复预填,导致严重服务退化。
因此,我们报告,这两人在一个固定的一小时窗口上奔跑,有些请求在截止日期时仍未完成。

blocks.en: A.2.2 Context Engineering Baseline Details
blocks.zh: A.2.2 背景工程基线细节

blocks.en:
Our context engineering baselines adopt Pi’s summarization prompts, conversation serialization, cut-point selection, and summary-generation budgets ( earendil-works, 2026 ) , with reserveTokens =16,384 and keepRecentTokens =20,000 across experimental groups.
Summarization uses the agent’s model and reasoning settings, replacing older dialogue with a summary while preserving system and developer instructions and the selected recent messages.

总结使用代理商的模型和推理设置,在保存系统和开发者指令以及选定的最近消息的同时,用一个摘要取代旧对话框.

blocks.en:
Unlike Pi’s native trigger based on the context window minus the reserve-token budget, we trigger compaction when the exact prompt token count reaches the threshold specified in Section 5.1 .
We also reject empty summaries and handle summarization failures according to the benchmark error protocol without retry.

我们还拒绝空摘要,并根据基准错误协议处理归纳失败,而不重试。

blocks.en:
Pi defines four prompt templates: a shared system prompt, an initial-summary prompt, an update-summary prompt, and a turn-prefix prompt.
For brevity, we reproduce the shared system and turn-prefix prompts below.

Do NOT respond to any questions in the conversation. ONLY output the structured summary.

blocks.en:
We estimate API-equivalent inference costs using the fixed token prices listed in Table 6 .
Our cost accounting includes only the evaluated agent’s generations and its context-summary calls.
We use Groq’s rates ( Groq, n.d. ) for GPT-OSS-120B and GPT-OSS-20B, and MiniMax’s official rates for MiniMax-M2.7.

For AKV’s cache repositioning, we also charge it at the cache-hit rate as a conservative estimate of the cost of key rotation.

blocks.zh: A.4 其他实验结果

blocks.en: A.4.1 Speedup Breakdown
blocks.zh: A.4.1 速度细分

blocks.en:
AKV accelerates decoding primarily by reducing full-attention time.
As shown in Figure 12 , at the same batch size, AKV reduces full-attention time by 59.8% and total decode-step time by 16.0% relative to Standard.
Dropping older tool-response KV shortens the active context, so subsequent decode steps load less KV data from GPU memory and perform fewer attention computations.
blocks.zh:
AKV主要通过减少全勤时间来加速解码.
如图12所示,AKV的批量大小相同,相对于标准,AKV将全程注意时间减少59.8%,总解码步骤时间减少16.0%.
丢弃更古老的工具-应答 KV会缩短活动上下文,因此后续的解码步骤加载GPU内存的KV数据较少,并进行较少的注意计算.

blocks.zh: A.4.2 成本细目和活跃背景长度

blocks.en:
Cost breakdown .
AKV lowers costs by reducing cache reads and repeated prefill.
As shown in Figure 14 , dropping older tool-response KV reduces the amount of cached history read by subsequent requests, lowering cache-read costs by approximately 17% relative to Standard.
Compared with Text Engineering, AKV reuses retained KV directly without the re-prefill required when summarization rewrites the history.
This reduces re-prefill computation and lowers cache-miss input costs by approximately 48%.
blocks.zh:
费用细目
AKV通过减少缓存读数和重复预填来降低成本.
如图14所示,投放较旧的工具响应KV会减少后续请求读取的缓存历史量,相对于标准将缓存阅读成本降低约17%.
与Text Engine相比,AKV的再利用直接保留了KV,在总和重写历史时不需要重新预补.
这样可以减少再预置计算,并将缓存故障输入成本降低约48%.

blocks.en:
Active context length .
Figure 14 shows how AKV slows the growth of active context.
Once tool responses exceed the retention budget of K K rounds, AKV continually drops older tool-response KV while retaining the most recent K K rounds and reasoning KV.
The active context therefore continues to grow as reasoning accumulates, but at a substantially slower rate.
In contrast, Standard accumulates history until summarization triggers a sharp reduction in context length.
blocks.zh:
活动上下文长度 。
图14显示了AKV如何减缓活跃环境的增长.
一旦工具响应超过K回合的保留预算,AKV会不断下降旧的工具响应KV,同时保留最新的K K回合和推理KV.
因此,随着推理的积累,积极环境继续增长,但速度要慢得多。
相比之下,标准积累了历史,直到归纳触发上下文长度的急剧缩短.

blocks.en: A.4.3 Attention Across Message History
blocks.zh: A.4.3 信息史上的注意

blocks.en: Figure 15: Attention density across message history. Attention density per token by layer and message index averaged over 10 selected BrowseComp-Plus trajectories, divided into old reasoning, old tool responses, and recent history.
blocks.zh: 图15:信息史上的注意力密度。 按图层和消息指数分列的每个信使的注意力密度平均超过10个选定的浏览器Comp-Plus轨迹,分为旧推理,旧工具响应和近代历史.

blocks.en:
To explain why our tool-response rolling-drop policy prioritizes dropping older tool-response KV entries, we analyze the attention allocated to different types of historical messages.
Figure 15 shows attention per token across layers averaged over 10 BrowseComp-Plus trajectories.
Older tool responses receive less attention than older reasoning in most displayed layers, while recent history generally receives more attention.
This pattern suggests that direct attention to historical messages depends on both recency and message type, providing empirical support for retaining recent tool responses and reasoning while preferentially dropping older tool-response KV entries.
Together with the task performance and cost results reported earlier, this observation helps explain how AKV reduces KV-cache access while maintaining task performance.
blocks.zh:
为了解释我们的工具-反应滚动投放政策为何优先考虑掉旧的工具-反应KV条目,我们分析了对不同类型历史信息的注意。
图15显示平均在10个浏览器Comp-Plus轨迹上对每个信物的注意。
在大多数显示的层中,老工具的响应受到的关注比老推理少,而近代历史一般受到更多的关注.
这种模式表明,对历史信息的直接关注既取决于是否正确,也取决于信息类型,为保留最近的工具响应和推理提供经验性支持,同时优先放下旧的工具响应KV条目.
这一观察与先前报告的任务性能和成本结果一起,有助于解释AKV如何在保持任务性能的同时减少KV-cache访问.

blocks.en:
Compatibility with Harness .
To assess whether AKV improves an existing harness, we integrate it with Pi ( earendil-works, 2026 ) and evaluate the combination on BCP. For both GPT-OSS-120B and GPT-OSS-20B, adding AKV improves accuracy by 3% over the native Pi harness without compaction and 4% over the Pi harness with compaction.

与哈妮丝的兼容性
为了评估AKV是否改进了现有的牵引装置,我们将其与Pi(earendil-works,2026)结合,并在BCP上评价组合. 对GPT-OSS-120B和GPT-OSS-20B来说,加上AKV使原生皮带的精度提高了3%,对无紧凑的皮带的精度提高了4%。

blocks.en:
We further evaluate AKV on GPT-OSS-20B ( Agarwal et al., 2025 ) , a smaller model from the same model family as GPT-OSS-120B, and compare its pass rate and cost against the Standard and Text Engineering baselines.
GPT-OSS-20B is evaluated with high reasoning effort across all methods.
We use the same thresholds as for GPT-OSS-120B: 96K tokens for Standard summarization and AKV’s repos \operatorname{repos} , and 48K tokens for Text Engineering.
As shown in Table 7 , AKV achieves the highest average pass rate of 45.2%, while maintaining a comparable average cost of 4.8 cents. In particular, AKV achieves the best pass rate on BCP and SWE-Verified, and the lowest cost on GAIA-Text and xbench-DS. On several metrics where AKV does not outperform the baselines, we attribute the smaller gains to the more limited capability of GPT-OSS-20B: compared with GPT-OSS-120B, the smaller model is less able to effectively leverage the retained information under cache engineering, making it more sensitive to cache modifications.
blocks.zh:
我们进一步评价了GPT-OSS-20B上的AKV(Agarwal等人,2025年),这是与GPT-OSS-120B相同的模型家族中一个较小的模型,并将它的通过率和成本与标准和文本工程基线进行比较。
对GPT-OSS-20B的评价涉及所有方法的高度推理。
我们使用与GPT-OSS-120B相同的阈值:标准总和的96K令牌和AKV的重置\operatorname{repos},以及文本工程的48K令牌。
如表7所示,AKV的平均通过率最高,为45.2%,同时保持4.8美分的可比平均费用。 特别是,AKV在BCP和SWE-Verifed上实现了最佳的通过率,在GAIA-Text和xbench-DS上实现了最低的成本. 在AKV没有超过基线的几个度量标准上,我们把较小的增益归结为GPT-OSS-20B的有限能力:与GPT-OSS-120B相比,较小的模型在缓存工程下无法有效地利用保留的信息,使其对缓存修改更加敏感.

blocks.en: A.5 Additional Related Works
blocks.zh: A.5 其他相关工程

blocks.en:
Concurrent works .
Concurrent work adapts KV eviction to the changing attention needs of agent trajectories.
AgentKV ( Liu et al., 2026a ) scores KV entries using query buffers from different execution phases, retaining information that recency-based scoring can miss.
IntentKV ( Li et al., 2026 ) combines cross-turn query memory with learned importance estimates to preserve useful history under limited KV budgets.
SideQuest ( Kariyappa and Suh, 2026 ) explores model-directed retention through an auxiliary reasoning branch that identifies stale tool results and issues cache-deletion commands, but its current strategy is limited to tool responses, and its serving integration is tailored to this specific eviction workflow.
Context Language Models (CLMs) ( Shao et al., 2026 ) primarily study model-driven context management, treating the live context as an editable file and learning how to maintain it.
CLM also introduces Suffix Cache Reuse to preserve unchanged downstream KV states after text edits.
Its serving support centers on session-local reuse: relocated states remain in private buffers outside the shared radix cache, without a unified mechanism for indexing, managing, and recovering these history-dependent states.
AKV addresses these serving concerns directly by exposing policy-independent cache operations through a stateless interface and uses an extended radix tree to track both tokens and cache operation histories, integrating retained states into shared cache reuse, memory management, and recovery.
blocks.zh:
同时工作。
同时期工作使KV驱离适应了物剂轨迹不断变化的关注需求.
AgentKV (Liu et al., 2026a) 使用不同执行阶段的查询缓冲器对KV条目进行评分,保留基于recency的评分可能错失的信息.
IntentKV(Li et al., 2026)将交叉转盘查询内存与学到的重要性估计结合起来,以在有限的KV预算下保存有用的历史.
SideQuest (Kariyappa and Suh, 2026)通过一个辅助推理分支来探索模型定向保留,该分支识别 Stale 工具结果并发布缓存-删除命令,但其当前策略仅限于工具响应,其服务集成也适应了这一具体的驱逐工作流程.
上下文语言模型(CLMs)(Shao等人,2026年)主要研究模型驱动的上下文管理,将直播上下文视为可编辑文件,并学习如何维护.
CLM还引入了后缀缓存重用,以在文本编辑后保留不变的下游KV状态.
其服务支持中心为会话-局部再利用:被迁移的状态仍然停留在共享的光栅缓存以外的私人缓冲处,没有统一的索引机制,管理和恢复这些依赖历史的状态.
AKV通过无国籍界面曝光政策独立的缓存操作,直接解决这些服务关切,并使用扩展的radx树来跟踪符和缓存操作历史,将保留状态整合到共享缓存再利用,内存管理和恢复中.
